question: In which year was the Manipur Appropriation Bill passed by the Parliament of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Manipur Appropriation Bill** pertains to financial legislation aimed at authorizing expenditure from the Consolidated Fund of India for the state of Manipur. It follows constitutional provisions for state budgeting.
 
• The **Manipur Appropriation Bill** was passed by the **Parliament of India** in the year **2025**, ensuring the allocation of funds for specific purposes in the state.
 
• Appropriation Bills are introduced annually after the presentation of the Budget, which details the estimated expenditures and revenues for the fiscal year.
 
• Such bills are significant as they enable the government to legally withdraw funds from the Consolidated Fund of India to meet the expenses specified in the budget.
